description: Send a change: whole files to write (path and full content) and files to delete. SPOE checks it (for an app: its migrations on a fresh Postgres and its API routes) and a second AI from another model family reviews it. On a project that applies changes on its own (the default) a change the review passes goes in as a version the owner can undo; one with a high or critical finding, or over a file the owner edited since, waits for the owner in the studio. Costs only the review's credits (estimated now, charged when it finishes, never if it fails). Then call change_status: fix what the findings say and send the files again.

files.description: Up to 200 files, 3 MB of text in all. Each is { path, content } to write the whole file, or { path, delete: true }.

summary.description: What this change does, in a sentence or two. The reviewer reads it beside the files.
